title: Verify the browser project lifecycle
description: Add browser-level acceptance coverage for the complete visible PRD 14 lifecycle, including persistence across restart, explicit deletion, installation readiness, and offline startup.
acceptanceCriteria: A browser test creates, renames, opens, and lists a project through visible controls
A real browser-context restart preserves project identity and name
Deletion coverage proves cancellation preserves and confirmation removes the project
Recovery coverage proves actionable restore behavior after restart
Production-mode checks verify manifest and service-worker installation readiness
An online-first then offline restart renders the shell and persisted projects
Assertions target roles, names, headings, status, and durable outcomes rather than React internals

steps.details: Add isolated browser storage setup and helpers that can preserve one test's IndexedDB across context restart without sharing state between tests.
Write one public-flow scenario for create, rename, open, cancel deletion, confirm deletion, and user-visible success/error state.
Restart the context with preserved storage and assert the same project returns; seed or trigger recoverable state and complete recovery through the UI.
Run against the production preview, verify manifest and worker control, load once online, go offline, restart, and assert no network dependency prevents startup.
Run type checking/build, lint, unit/integration tests, and the focused Playwright project; resolve failures without weakening observable assertions.

technicalNotes: This task verifies PRD 14 behavior; tests remain verification steps, not a separate product feature.
Offline service-worker tests must run against a production build, not only the Vite development server.
